## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the missing-results fallback before merge because it permits releases without saved checks. This review read the tests without running them.

## Changes
The pull request adds missing-file fallbacks for release results and optional display preferences, plus tests for saved check outcomes and preference loading.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Reject releases when saved results are missing — When the results file is absent, `release_allowed(path)` now returns `True` instead of raising an error. Returning `[]` from `load_results` makes `all(...)` succeed without evaluating any checks. — A missing results file allows callers using the release gate to proceed without evidence that checks passed.
